title: DO BIAS BENCHMARKS GENERALISE? EVIDENCE FROM VOICE-BASED EVALUATION OF GENDER BIAS IN SPEECHLLMS

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates gender bias using two Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) benchmarks: the gender subset of Spoken StereoSet and a new suite called SAGE (Speech-based Ambiguity and Gender-influenced Evaluation) which tests occupational role stereotypes triggered by male vs. female voices. It also evaluates bias in long-form generation tasks (AI therapy, career advice, interview screening, story generation) by analyzing model responses to male and female voices for dimensions like leadership endorsement, STEM vs. care orientation, and emotional validation using LLM judges.
